claims.claim: The effect threshold E of 139.3 degrees was driven by the 1M real-time arm, whose lag varied by 69.7 degrees across its last three checkpoints, while the two full-recipe arms varied by 6.2 and 6.4 degrees.
When the decision script is given only the two full-recipe arms, E becomes 15 degrees and the decision is still 'no difference within the budget', the same as with all four arms.
The 1M real-time arm had no successful worlds at any of its last three checkpoints.
When given only the two full-recipe arms, the decision script concludes that real-time playback is better.
